text: わしは　つりも　だいすきだが　でっかい　コイキングを　みるのも　たまらんほど　すきなんじゃ！

structure.jp: わしは　つりも　だいすきだが
でっかい　コイキングを　みるのも
たまらんほど　すきなんじゃ！
structure.en: I love so much I can't stand it!

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: コイキングを　みるの
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. コイキングを　みるの = 'looking at Magikarp'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ adds the feeling of explaining yourself: 'the thing is'. んじゃ is the old-man form of it. すきなんじゃ = 'I love it, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a part of a sentence means 'but'. つりも　だいすきだが = 'I love fishing too, but'.
